title: Design loads.
officialText: Shallow foundations shall be designed for the most unfavorable effects due to the combinations of loads specified in Section 1605.3. The dead load shall include the weight of shallow foundations and overlying fill. Reduced live loads, as specified in Section 1607.9, are permitted to be used in the design of shallow foundations.
